_comment: 居合: the blade laid back along the left hip as if sheathed, the right hand across on the hilt, the left on the scabbard (0-8); a long low stance, front knee bent, rear leg long, eyes on the thing (8-16); still (16-36); the draw, one flat cut from the left hip to full stretch at the right, the body passing through (36-38, through at 38); held (38-50, it falls at 50); up a little (50-56); the flick (56-60); held (60-64); the stance (64-72).
